not_recomputable.placement_scarcity: needs the candidate placement counts at that step and when the request was first seen (environment state, not in the trace)
not_recomputable.resource_contention: needs the set of valid requests and their candidate antennas at that step (not in the trace)
not_recomputable.mission_unmet_ratio: needs seconds allocated and requested per mission at that step (not in the trace)
not_recomputable.initial_contention: contention when the request was first seen in the episode (not in the trace)
not_recomputable.mean_mission_unmet: mean over all missions at that step (not in the trace)
